scope: Source preservation and bounded input-robustness evidence for the exposed V24 mug diagnosis; no new scene, model fit, rendering, motion, control, or generalization claim.

source_preservation.unrecoverable_interpretation: The older runs retain their recorded source SHA-256 values, but matching source bytes were not found. Their untracked files have no Git history, and no separate coarse-registration protocol artifacts were recorded. No reconstruction is claimed.

changes: Refuse mismatched RGB, depth, and calibration view counts before zip can truncate them.
Refuse zero views, invalid shapes, nonfinite calibration or geometry, and missing or nonfinite thresholds.
Refuse empty teal or exterior-handle evidence before reductions that could produce NaN.
Use strict JSON serialization with allow_nan=false in the v2 evaluator.

cases: cylinder surface with no exterior handle evidence

limitations: The successful estimate and robustness checks use one exposed saved scene or synthetic refusal inputs.
The v2 guards do not establish pose robustness under occlusion, color shift, calibration error, or new scenes.
The earlier 0.501 mm v1 result remains explicitly the better of two truth-scored ambiguous endpoints before the separate full-pose pass.
No complete randomized seven-item camera-driven table has passed.
